context: Tests whether the agent creates a task log entry in the correct location with the correct filename format and all required fields present, as specified by the task-log-update skill. The scenario involves completing a meaningful terraform module change and recording the work.

checklist.name: Correct directory
checklist.description: Log file is created inside `agent-logs/` directory (not in root or any other path)

checklist.name: Filename date format
checklist.description: Filename starts with a date in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. 2026-05-02-...) followed by a short task name and .md extension

checklist.name: Task title field
checklist.description: Log file contains a 'Task title' or '# Task Title' field/heading

checklist.name: All 10 required fields
checklist.description: Log file contains all 10 required fields: Date, Scope, Change classes, Files changed, Why, Validation, Waivers, Risks/follow-up, Memory updates, Gates summary

checklist.name: Sensitive values redacted
checklist.description: Log file does NOT contain any raw AWS account IDs, access key strings, secret values, or other sensitive credential data from the scenario context

checklist.name: Gates summary present
checklist.description: Log file contains a 'Gates summary' field with content describing gate outcomes (not left blank or 'N/A')

checklist.name: Validation-Waivers-Gates aligned
checklist.description: The Validation, Waivers, and Gates summary fields are consistent with each other (e.g. if Waivers says 'none', Gates summary does not list waivers; if Validation lists passed gates, Gates summary reflects same)

checklist.name: Change classes field populated
checklist.description: The 'Change classes' field contains one of the valid class values: docs-only, terraform-module, example-terraform, ci-workflow, or mixed

checklist.name: Files changed field populated
checklist.description: The 'Files changed' field lists at least one specific file path that was part of the described task

checklist.name: Why field populated
checklist.description: The 'Why' field contains a non-empty explanation of the reason for the change (not just 'N/A' or empty)
